<function name="GetTextAlign" parent="DListView_Column" type="panelfunc">
	<description>Returns the text alignment for the column</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="alignment" type="number{ContentAlignment}">The direction of the content, based on the number pad. See <page>Enums/ContentAlignment</page>.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
